remarks: Ideally located in the West Norwalk neighborhood. Enjoy easy access to I95, 7 minutes to the South Norwalk Metro North Station, 6 minutes to the local public golf course, 4 minutes to the popular SONO collection, less than 1 mile from grocery stores, pharmacies, shopping, and dining, and just 13 minutes to Norwalk's public beach area. Residents of Norwalk get to enjoy free access to the Connecticut shoreline, picnic area, splashpad, playgrounds, waterfront dining, entertainment, and Taylor Farm dog park. This home has been totally renovated, new floors, tiles, vanity, light fixtures, and freshly painted. Cozy up by the woodburning fireplace in the living room. Enjoy cooking in the eat-in-kitchen with granite counters, stainless-steel appliances, and ample cabinet storage. A totally updated 1st floor bathroom. 2 well-proportioned 1st floor bedrooms. The lower level offers 720 square feet of additional space for whatever you need. Enjoy the warmer months in your private, level, fenced-in backyard. Walk-up attic. Detached garage. This home is registered with the 100% Money Back Guarantee Program. Some images are virtually staged.
